lines.text: Your habits are either building the person you want to become...
Or destroying the potential you have.
Think about it.
Every time you wake up and immediately scroll through your phone, you're building a habit.
Every time you procrastinate, you're building a habit.
And every time you choose to do something productive, you're building one too.
The scary part?
Your habits don't just determine what you do today.
They determine who you become tomorrow.
So how do you change them?
First, make good habits ridiculously easy to start.
Want to read more?
Start with just one page a day.
Want to get fitter?
Start with a ten minute workout.
Second, make bad habits harder to access.
Put your phone in another room.
Delete the apps wasting your time.
Remove the things constantly tempting you.
And finally, stop relying on motivation.
Build a routine and stick to it, even when you don't feel like it.
Remember...
You don't change your life overnight.
You change it one habit at a time.
Your future self is being built by what you do today.
The next version.
